verdicts.reason: A: a clean left-to-right banner with a big headline and a large, clear CTA. But the '48H ONLY' badge has shrunk until it can't be read, the box is crowded into the bottom-left corner, and the lime panel now bleeds off the edge, so the original's framed card is gone. B keeps the framed lime card, which is more faithful, but it has the same unreadable badge, the box is jammed against the bottom edge, and the body copy and CTA are squeezed into a small right column. That leaves the CTA weak and dead space to the left of the headline.
